Definition: from the same as G2141; pecuniary resources:--wealth.
BiblicalUsage: euporía means wealth. In Acts 19:25, the text says "ye know that by this craft we have our wealth."
TheologicalSignificance: I read euporía plainly — it means wealth, and I do not build a doctrine on it.
